_note: v2 hook overrides for l'observatoire & météo (B32_ciel). Source hooks are kept wherever the painting shows them; these replace only hooks whose painted scene differs from the source text (or that name a printed sign or a brewery), so the card always describes what is in the picture.

fr_tempete_noun.why: The painting shows the poodle floating up on its own, without its owner.

fr_brouillard_noun.why: owner review: a witch's brew fogging the yard replaces the shivering boy Text pass 2026-10-28: bracketed respelling matched to the card (broo-YAR -> broo-YAHR).

fr_tonnerre_noun.why: The painting turns the 'ton of noise' into a real one-ton weight dropping from a cloud.

fr_foudre_noun_f.why: Paintings carry no text, so the truck has no sign to light up.

fr_prevision_noun.why: The painting shows the crystal ball by itself, to avoid a second girl next to the girl with cloud hair.

fr_univers_noun.why: owner review: a unicycle shared by a bunch of galaxies replaces the rubber duck

fr_lune_noun.why: The painting puts the loon on a stone tower in the star garden, not on the observatory.

fr_galaxie_noun.why: The painting shows the galaxy in the open sky rather than on a planetarium dome.

fr_secheresse_noun.why: The painted scarecrow stands by the sunflower without a fan.

fr_gel_noun.why: owner review: the frost needs gelatin

fr_ouragan_noun.why: owner review: Oregon covered by a hurricane

fr_mistral_noun.why: The painting shows the scarf flying in the wind; her hat and shopping list stay put.

fr_meteorologique_adj.why: The painted instrument stand has a wind vane and a rain gauge but no thermometer. The owl in spectacles is now a woman scientist. Lesson 2: no anthropomorphic animals unless the animal IS the hook.

fr_lancement_noun.why: The painting sets the toy launch outdoors beside the observatory.

fr_astronome_noun.why: The painting has only one garden gnome (le nain), so the astronomer is drawn as a person.

fr_eclair_noun.why: RECS 1.4: weather sense; the pastry is a separate entry (fr_eclair_noun_2, bakery).

fr_atmosphere_noun.why: owner review: the atmosphere should involve a sphere

fr_spatial_adj.why: owner review: cowboy-hat cat saying y'all

fr_globe_noun.hook: Like English 'globe', said GLOB: a giant GLOBE stands on the headland with a big blue GLOB of goo dripping off its North Pole.
fr_globe_noun.why: painting shows the goo blob on the globe, no child

fr_soleil_noun.hook: The SUN lounges in a striped deckchair, SO LAZY: soh-LEHY = so la(zy).
fr_soleil_noun.why: painting shows the sun in a deckchair, not on a nest

fr_neige_noun.why: The bird no longer wears earmuffs; it is a plain bird. Lesson 2: no anthropomorphic animals unless the animal IS the hook.

fr_satellite_noun.why: The owl just flies (no waving). Lesson 2: no anthropomorphic animals unless the animal IS the hook.

fr_eternite_noun.why: No bag lunch is painted, and the snail stays a plain snail. Lesson 2: no anthropomorphic animals unless the animal IS the hook.

fr_verglas_noun.why: The penguin slides on its belly like a real penguin instead of skating like a person. Lesson 2: no anthropomorphic animals unless the animal IS the hook. Text pass 2026-10-28: bracketed respelling matched to the card (ver-GLAH -> vehr-GLAH).

fr_lunaire_adj.why: The rabbit in a spacesuit is now a girl astronaut. Lesson 2: no anthropomorphic animals unless the animal IS the hook.

fr_pole_noun.why: A child plants the flag; the penguin is a plain penguin. Lesson 2: no anthropomorphic animals unless the animal IS the hook.

fr_bise_noun.en: north wind; also: a kiss on the cheek (faire la bise)
fr_bise_noun.why: RECS 1.4: weather room = the north wind; the kissing bees were repainted as bees braced against the wind.

fr_canicule_noun.why: Moved from horloge (1.2 B/C); weather room. Painting shows exactly this.

fr_orage_noun.why: Text pass 2026-10-28: bracketed respelling matched to the card (o-RAZH -> oh-RAHZH).

fr_ciel_noun.why: Text pass 2026-10-28: bracketed respelling matched to the card (SYEL -> SYEHL).

fr_illuminer_verb.why: Illuminate → illuminer = to light up (les lumières illuminent la ville à Noël). RED beret = regular -er. Wave 1 oct29: moved from st_ciel/soleil into ciel/etoiles; hook rewritten to match the new painting.

fr_eclairer_verb.why: CLEAR, éclair (a flash) → éclairer = to light up (la lampe éclaire la table); also to enlighten. RED beret = regular -er. Wave 1 oct29: moved from st_sommeil/levetot into ciel/etoiles; hook rewritten to match the new painting.

fr_endormir_verb.why: DORMANT → s'endormir = to fall asleep (le bébé s'endort vite); endormir = to put to sleep. Reflexive: the mirror; être (il s'est endormi). GOLD beret = irregular (je m'endors, nous nous endormons). Wave 1 oct29: moved from st_sommeil/st_sommeil into ciel/etoiles; hook rewritten to match the new painting.
